description: Block rendering an editable key/value properties table for the page, with an add-row button and per-row key input, value textarea, and delete, plus an empty state.

parameters.name: Block
parameters.description: Owning page block for persistence context.

parameters.name: OnContentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when edited page properties should be persisted.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Raised when the block receives focus.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether the properties table is rendered without editing affordances.
